name: Palo Alto
callout: Highest asking rent in the Valley. Scarcity still prices.

name: Mountain View / Los Altos
callout: Softest vacancy print. Product and tenant mix, not just cycle.

name: Sunnyvale
callout: YTD absorption still the Valley’s largest positive — Q4 gave some back.

name: West Valley
callout: Tightest smaller pocket. Limited block size.

name: Santa Clara
callout: Positive Q4. Power and campus adjacency decide who takes it.

name: San Jose IBP
callout: Lowest vacancy in the set. Industrial-R&D hybrid still clearing.

name: San Jose — North
callout: Largest give-back in Q4 after Fremont’s gain.

name: San Jose South
callout: Availability still elevated. Price is not the whole story.

name: Milpitas
callout: Negative both Q4 and YTD. Watch large-block vacancy.

name: Fremont / Newark
callout: The Q4 resilience print. +304k SF while the Valley net was negative.
